findings.description: CacheKey type as u64 for identifying extents
findings.notes: CacheKey re-exported from interfaces crate

findings.description: Per-entry metadata: location, size_blocks, read_ref, write_ref, tsc with Mutex/Condvar
findings.notes: DispatchEntry struct with all required fields; DispatchMapState uses Mutex+Condvar

findings.description: create_staging allocates DMA buffer, records entry with write_ref=1, error on size=0 or alloc failure
findings.notes: Validates size!=0, checks duplicate key, uses injected DmaAllocFn

findings.description: lookup returns NotExist/Staging/BlockDevice/MemoryTier, increments read_ref, blocks on active write with 2000ms timeout, refreshes TSC
findings.notes: All specified behaviors implemented correctly including timeout and TSC refresh

findings.description: convert_to_storage transitions Staging->BlockDevice, sets ssd_offset on MemoryTier, conditional read_ref decrement
findings.notes: Error on already BlockDevice; conditional decrement only if read_ref>0

findings.description: take_read waits until write_ref=0 with 2000ms timeout, then increments read_ref
findings.notes: Uses wait_for with DEFAULT_TIMEOUT

findings.description: take_write waits until read_ref=0 and write_ref=0 with 2000ms timeout
findings.notes: Uses wait_for with DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; sets write_ref=1

findings.description: release_read decrements read_ref, error on underflow
findings.notes: Returns RefCountUnderflow if read_ref already 0

findings.description: release_write decrements write_ref, error on underflow
findings.notes: Returns RefCountUnderflow if write_ref already 0

findings.description: downgrade_reference atomically transitions write to read reference
findings.notes: write_ref=0, read_ref+=1 in single critical section; error if no write ref held

findings.description: remove deletes entry, error if active references
findings.notes: Checks read_ref>0 || write_ref>0 before removal

findings.description: initialize recovers extents via IExtentManager::for_each_extent; Ok(()) if unbound
findings.notes: Populates map with BlockDevice entries from extent manager; handles unbound case

findings.description: All methods thread-safe and re-entrant
findings.notes: All state behind Mutex<Inner>; Condvar for blocking; no unsafe concurrent access

findings.description: ILogger receptacle used for info, debug, and error logging
findings.notes: Logger used in set_dma_alloc, initialize, create_staging, lookup, convert_to_storage, all ref operations, remove, memory-tier methods

findings.description: define_component! with IDispatchMap provider, ILogger and IExtentManager receptacles
findings.notes: Correct macro usage with version, provides, receptacles, and fields

findings.description: touch(key) updates TSC without acquiring references, returns KeyNotFound if missing
findings.notes: Updates entry.tsc via rdtsc(); no ref count modification

findings.description: oldest_keys(n) returns up to n keys sorted by ascending TSC
findings.notes: Collects all entries, sorts by tsc, takes n; thread-safe via mutex

findings.description: MemoryTier variant with pointer/size/ssd_offset; create_memory_tier_entry and convert_memory_tier_to_block methods
findings.notes: Spec says convert_memory_tier_to_block(key, offset) but implementation is convert_memory_tier_to_block(key) — reads offset from ssd_offset field already set by convert_to_storage. Minor signature mismatch.

findings.description: set_dma_alloc(alloc) injects DMA allocator for create_staging
findings.notes: Stores in Mutex<Option<DmaAllocFn>>; logs when set

findings.description: initialize() is explicit public API, not called during construction
findings.notes: Constructor only sets up state; initialize() must be called explicitly

findings.description: convert_to_storage on MemoryTier sets ssd_offset rather than transitioning to BlockDevice
findings.notes: Match arm for Location::MemoryTier sets *ssd_offset = Some(offset)

findings.description: is_evictable(key) returns true iff MemoryTier with ssd_offset:Some and no active refs
findings.notes: Checks read_ref==0, write_ref==0, Location::MemoryTier{ssd_offset: Some(_)}; false for all other cases

findings.description: entry_size(key) returns size in bytes (size_blocks * 4096) without acquiring references
findings.notes: Returns KeyNotFound if key does not exist

unspecced.feature: recover_extent(key, offset, size_blocks) — directly inserts BlockDevice entry
unspecced.notes: Present in IDispatchMap interface; used for incremental recovery bypassing initialize()

unspecced.feature: entry_size() module-level free function — returns sizeof(DispatchEntry)
unspecced.notes: Benchmark/assertion utility; distinct from FR-023 entry_size(key) instance method
